//: Browsers of the Firefox e2e suite (tools/e2e/browsers.ts), Linux x86_64. Each archive must hash to the sha256 pinned here before it is unpacked; nothing else is trusted. The first firefox entry is the default; CI runs every entry (the latest release and the minimum ESR, strict_min_version 153.0) through INTACTWARDEN_E2E_FIREFOX_VERSION. To bump a version, take the line of linux-x86_64/en-US/firefox-<version>.tar.xz from Mozilla's SHA256SUMS next to the release, checking SHA256SUMS.asc with gpg against the Mozilla release key (14F26682D0916CDD81E37B6D61B7B526D98F0353) before you paste the digest.
